reuse.why: Adds the flag to the shared LinkAccountBaseParams so it flows through every provider's spread into the existing linkBankSyncAccount, and extracts the local part of unlinkAccount into clearAccountLink so both paths share it.

duplication.why: The unlinked-account field reset is moved into one helper used by unlinkAccount and by the takeover, instead of being copied.

placement.why: The takeover is decided inside the single shared link routine, after the closed-account check, next to the existing duplicate-link rule; the helper sits beside unlinkAccount.

scope.why: Only the flag, the extracted helper and tests covering each required behaviour.

maintainability.why: Small, readable change: one branch in the shared link routine and one named helper that defines what an unlinked account looks like.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All providers go through linkBankSyncAccount; clearing goes through clearAccountLink.

disguised_duplication.where: No duplicated logic; the clearing block was extracted, not copied.
